T: Ohana means nobody gets left out of dinner.
D: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts a strange blue dog who turns out to be an alien experiment.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Lilo takes Pudge the fish his peanut butter sandwich.
S: Pudge's peanut butter and banana toasties
the fish who controls the weather, fed every Thursday

Crunchy peanut butter, sliced banana and a drizzle of honey in buttered white bread, toasted golden in a pan and cut into fish shapes. Spread 8 slices of white bread on one side with 40g soft butter. Turn over and spread 4 slices with crunchy peanut butter, top with sliced banana from 2 bananas and a drizzle of honey, then close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into fish shapes with a cutter, or into triangles.
Sashimi tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion, chilli and a little seaweed, served on rice crackers.
the surfing day with Nani and David

Shell-on prawns fried hard in butter with a whole bulb of garlic, lemon and parsley, served over sticky rice with lemon wedges, island shrimp truck style. Cut down the backs of 800g shell-on green prawns and devein, leaving the shells on. Toss with 2 tbsp plain flour, 1 tsp paprika and salt. Cook 300g sushi rice. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp oil and fry 12 chopped garlic cloves gently for 3 minutes until golden. Add the prawns and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, tossing, until pink. Finish with lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the rice.
M: Beef patties seasoned and seared in a hot pan, set on steamed rice, smothered in a brown onion gravy made in the same pan with stock and butter, topped with a runny fried egg.
the whole family around the table

Smoky pork shoulder slow-roasted in banana leaves until it falls apart, with coconut rice, pineapple salsa and a crunchy cabbage slaw. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 1 tbsp sea salt and 1 tsp smoked paprika, wrap in banana leaves or foil and roast in a covered dish at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Shred in the juices. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water. Dice half a pineapple with red onion, chilli, coriander and lime for salsa. Toss shredded cabbage with lime and sesame oil. Serve all together.
W: Stitch's number before he gets a name

Frozen pineapple blitzed with a little coconut cream and lime until thick, piped into cups and served straight away. Blitz 500g frozen pineapple with 100ml coconut cream, a squeeze of lime and a spoon of sugar until thick and smooth. Pipe into cups and serve straight away before it melts.
K: Pineapple juice, coconut cream and blue raspberry cordial blended with plenty of ice until slushy, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge.

Dice 300g sashimi tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, sliced spring onion and a little chilli. Spoon onto rice crackers and serve straight away.

m.how: Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and sear in a hot pan. Cook 300g jasmine rice. In the same pan, soften a sliced onion in 30g butter, stir in a spoon of flour and 400ml stock until thick. Serve patties on rice with gravy and a fried egg.

d.how: Blend 500ml pineapple juice, 150ml coconut cream, 60ml blue raspberry cordial and 3 cups ice until slushy. Pour into four tall glasses with a pineapple wedge. Ohana means family.
